provenance.criteria_rationale: Matched effects use actual means or medians of the supplied per-monomer frames, with no universal sign imposed. Local contact probability uses raw delta <= 4.35 angstrom (within the frozen 4.25-4.50 angstrom local-contact range). F opening is summarized by gamma median and the directly measured fraction >120 degrees. D opening is separately summarized as fraction gamma >=100 degrees, including AshAsp descriptively. Delta-gamma Pearson correlation is computed from aligned finite pairs within each of all 12 groups and is descriptive, not a claim of independent samples or causation. The shoulder test is the exact common radial-shape probe below; it does not equate a slope minimum with a secondary peak. Supplementary Fig. 17 does not override the supplied Fig. 8b series where their reported apical interpretations differ.

criteria.shape_method: histogram probability density divided by r^2; gaussian_filter1d; np.gradient; scipy.signal.find_peaks(-slope)
